verdict.rationale: Honeybadger offers both a REST API for listing/fetching faults (honeybadger-docs-19) and an official hosted MCP server that gives an agent error investigation, project management, and BadgerQL insight capabilities (honeybadger-docs-13, honeybadger-probe-3), which supports the 'pull top issues and triage' half of the story. Filing real bugs into an external tracker is documented via GitHub/GitLab/Jira issue export (honeybadger-docs-23), though this is shown as a UI/webhook feature rather than explicitly exposed as an MCP or API action, and stack-trace content isn't explicitly confirmed as part of the API/MCP payload. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that MCP/API responses include full stack traces, and explicit evidence that the MCP server (not just UI) can trigger tracker-issue creation.
